---
title: TARA context
sidebar_position: 1
---

TARA stands for **Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment**. The project is intended
to make assessment work structured and traceable, addressing the difficulties
of scattered spreadsheet-based information described in the university brief.

## Standard reference

The brief requires consideration of **ISO/SAE 21434:2021**. This scaffold does not
reproduce the standard or define a scoring method. The team must review its
methods against the applicable source material and document the resulting
requirements and evidence.

## Planned assistance

Explanations and concise guidance during an assessment are desired. Optional
LLM assistance is being considered, but availability and review procedures are
not yet defined. This page will be expanded when those decisions are confirmed.
